objective: Verify that client_search Draft Judge preserves unresolved responsibility-boundary context when verifier.authority.enabled=false.

semantic_harness_findings.problem: Disabling Authority removed the case's boundary-candidate signals, while a project gate independently treated is_supported=false as proof that the field was in product scope. The compiled context and deterministic post-processing therefore fabricated a responsibility conclusion and forced not_fulfilled.

evidence.detail: not_evaluable responsibility/insufficient-evidence cases require an Authority-backed distinction; absence of investigation is not proof of either responsibility outcome.
The frozen report explicitly states that is_supported=false and entity-name absence do not decide out-of-scope versus in-scope missing capability.
Before remediation, 088/093/113/133 were all decisively not_fulfilled with no authority_tool_call_ids; 048 was a neighboring fulfilled case.

semantic_harness_findings.impact: Draft overstates business failures whenever the live output is empty and the missing dimension's responsibility boundary is unresolved, producing false regressions against Production.
semantic_harness_findings.remediation: Preserve authority_candidate_reasons when Authority is disabled, expose disabled_with_candidates in the compiled context, remove the false field-presence responsibility rule, and fail closed to not_evaluable plus needs_human_review for affected blocking assessments.
verification_evidence: Compiled contexts for 088/093/113/133 report authority_mode=disabled_with_candidates, retain candidate_reasons, expose no authority tool, and require no unavailable tool.
Replay of the original 001-run Draft results changes 088/093/113/133 from not_fulfilled to not_evaluable while 048 remains fulfilled.
39 targeted Judge investigation tests passed; 34 Authority/context-governance regression tests passed.
The only excluded test performs a real external LLM smoke call and failed from API connection errors, not an assertion related to this remediation.

unresolved_questions: The final responsibility classifications for 088/093/113/133 remain intentionally unresolved until Authority is enabled or formal business boundary material is added.

gate_impact.draft_loop: requires a new fingerprint and targeted rerun before review
gate_impact.promotion: blocked until the next Draft iteration demonstrates no neighboring regression
